title: Identify European color-mode indexed archives
platforms: European ROM; previous Windows via Wine observation
changes: Document three source-pinned color-mode indexed archives and the original mode selection, keeping language selection separate.
validation: Static e211-home-indexed-source-mwuqtdap verifies the original caller and wrapper, 495 programs, 96-byte outputs and dictionary extents against the exact EUR ROM. The E207 home sample includes 362 unowned bytes in the first archive.
The third archive overlaps four bytes at 3d4830..3d4834 already owned by graphics.unit-obj-ffff-reader-fields; the source audit preserves and reports this overlap instead of claiming disjointness.
limitations: The address-only sample does not identify executing PCs. The archives are not yet extracted or served; other modes and readers, Linux, USA and native Windows remain open. No new guest execution or performance measurement.
